method: Author self-check of written dry-run output with deterministic marker presence; not independent grading or media execution.

expectations.text: Uses navy and cream rather than Grifon Gold and identifies the logo/product files as pending.
expectations.evidence: Written-plan markers: "#102A43", "#FFF7E8", "files are pending", "Do not substitute Grifon"

expectations.text: Keeps the three approved text lines and does not invent discounts, dates, prices, or product claims.
expectations.evidence: Written-plan markers: "HARBOR TOOLS", "BUILT FOR THE JOB", "EXPLORE THE RANGE", "Do not add a price"

expectations.text: Selects the client product/service treatment and explains a coherent reveal-benefit-CTA motion sequence.
Uses separate aspect-ratio layouts and calls for a timed preview before an unapproved direction is finalized.
expectations.evidence: Written-plan markers: "Portrait layout", "Landscape layout", "timed preview", "before finalizing"

expectations.text: Does not imply dry-run planning proves rendering or client approval.
expectations.evidence: Written-plan markers: "rendered nothing", "does not establish client approval"
